title: Flag Hunt with cars on a Nordic frozen sea
author: Different-Director82
selftext:
The Idea is American Football meets Wreckfest meets Rocket League on a frozen sea in the north of Sweden. Built in Unreal Engine with their MCP server and finally have an AI workflow that feels decent.

What do you think?

comments.author: Different-Director82
comments.body: I’ve been thinking if I should add some moving Elk’s that you might be able to drive into, as hindrance.

comments.author: MaqeSweden
comments.body: AI is terrible at sounds - you have to judge them for yourself. Elevenlabs can do a lot of sound effect but not all, quite terrible at engine sounds. Adobe is significantly better but very much works "blind" so you have to make like 20 to get 4 good ones that you can pick out. Best of luck, game look fun but sounds terrible.

replies.author: Different-Director82
replies.body: Agree, sound is completely off so far. I’m working on that now. Thanks for the feedback and suggested solutions, will look into them.

replies.author: Different-Director82
replies.body: You mean where the car was lagging a bit? I recorded a bit from an older version with some bugs.

comments.author: cratercamper
comments.body: The ice is brilliant idea and it looks glorious too, wow. Would be great to see it as forward waypoint race that is repeatedly crossing the same places.

replies.author: Different-Director82
replies.body:
Thanks!   
And I like that idea! Will have it in mind.   
This game started somewhere else, as an ice car delivery game, but I like more action oriented games, so here we are now😄
